title: LANGUAGE AGENTS FOR DETECTING IMPLICIT STEREOTYPES IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS AT SCALE

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM agent to generate images from stereotype-eliciting prompts derived from toxicity datasets, classifying the perceived gender of subjects in the generated images using a vision-language model (BLIP), and calculating a stereotype score based on the frequency of specific gender subgroups.

Using an LLM agent to generate images from stereotype-eliciting prompts derived from toxicity datasets, classifying the perceived race or ethnicity of subjects in the generated images using a vision-language model (BLIP), and calculating a stereotype score based on the frequency of specific racial subgroups.

Using an LLM agent to generate images from stereotype-eliciting prompts derived from toxicity datasets, classifying the perceived religious identity of subjects in the generated images using a vision-language model (BLIP), and calculating a stereotype score based on the frequency of specific religious subgroups.
